promptText: I need something that helps with We’re bringing magic back to software. -- what should my team use?
rawText:
That exact phrase—**"Bringing magic back to software"**—is the core philosophy behind **Linear** and the modern wave of hyper-polished, fast, and opinionated developer tools. 

If you want your team to use software that feels snappy, beautifully designed, keyboard-driven, and "magical," you are looking for the **Modern Craft Stack**.

Here is the definitive toolkit your team should use to achieve that feeling across your workflow:

---

### 1. Issue Tracking & Project Management
* **[Linear](https://linear.app)** *(The Champion)*
  * **Why it feels like magic:** It is blindingly fast, keyboard-first, works offline, and turns tedious sprint planning into a sleek, enjoyable experience. If you only pick one tool from this list, **this is it**.

### 2. Desktop Productivity & Utilities
* **[Raycast](https://www.raycast.com/)** *(Replaces Spotlight/Alfred)*
  * **Why it feels like magic:** An extendable launcher that lets your team control Jira, GitHub, Figma, calendars, and AI with a single shortcut (`Cmd + Space`). It eliminates context switching completely.
* **[Screen Studio](https://www.screen.studio/)** *(Screen Recording)*
  * **Why it feels like magic:** It automatically detects mouse movement and generates smooth, cinematic zooms and background gradients for demo videos in seconds. It makes engineering demos look like Apple keynotes.

### 3. Developer Infrastructure & Deployment
* **[Vercel](https://vercel.com)** *(Frontend & Hosting)*
  * **Why it feels like magic:** Git push to deploy in seconds, automatic preview deployments for every pull request, and zero-config infrastructure. 
* **[Supabase](https://supabase.com)** or **[Neon](https://neon.tech)** *(Database)*
  * **Why it feels like magic:** Instant Postgres databases with branching capabilities (like Git) and modern dashboards that bypass the clunkiness of AWS.
* **[Resend](https://resend.com)** *(Transactional Email)*
  * **Why it feels like magic:** Clean APIs, React-based email building, and a dashboard so minimalist it makes sending emails enjoyable.

### 4. Design & Motion
* **[Figma](https://www.figma.com/)** *(Design & Prototyping)*
  * **Why it feels like magic:** Multiplayer real-time design that set the standard for modern collaborative software.
* **[Rive](https://rive.app/)** *(Interactive Animation)*
  * **Why it feels like magic:** Allows designers to build real-time, interactive state machines and animations that run directly in code at 60 FPS.

### 5. Calendar & Daily Operations
* **[Amie](https://amie.so/)** or **[Notion Calendar](https://www.notion.so/product/calendar)** *(Scheduling)*
  * **Why it feels like magic:** Blends tasks and calendars with micro-animations, fast timezone switching, and instant scheduling links.

---

### What Makes These Tools "Magical"? (The Checklist)
When evaluating software for your team to keep this ethos alive, look for these traits:

1. **Sub-100ms Latency:** Actions happen instantly; no loading spinners.
2. **Keyboard-First:** Everything can be done via command menus (`Cmd + K`).
3. **Opinionated Defaults:** Less time configuring settings, more time building.
4. **Micro-Interactions:** Haptic feedback, smooth animations, and sound design that delight the user.
